—Day 0 of the “Drawing Without a Ruler” Challenge
—Basically, there were just too many elements and too many variations—so many that I ended up forgetting to draw a lot of the details toward the end. Haha.
—Hina is so cute! I’m planning to release an illustration of her later.
—The next victim is tentatively set to be Iori.
—The vacation is almost over; time to get back to work.
